name: Divine Automaton
text: A machine that offers sacred boons—Life, Blessing, or Skip—to those who have earned enough gold in their journey.

name: Eagle's Breath
text: The power of the Eagle. It enhances your weapon to strike with three projectiles simultaneously, tripling your righteous fury.

name: Hotdog's Hounds
text: The bounty of the Hotdog. It deploys seeking missiles that automatically track and destroy the valley's inhabitants with mechanical precision.
